_note: r.164(3)(m): "in whose case payment or deduction of tax has been deferred under section 391(2) or section 392(3)"; (6)(n): "income of the nature specified in section 17(1)(d) on which tax is payable or deductible under section 391(2) or section 392(3)" — one fact, worded twice. s.391(2), s.392(3): tax on s.17(1)(d) income (specified security or sweat equity share) from an eligible start-up (s.140) is paid or deducted within the time in s.289(3). The question's wording is drafted by Claude, to be adopted by the owner; the clause is quoted from the Gazette. Valid for TY 2026-27 only: r.164(1) governs "the tax year commencing on the 1st April, 2026" (D-520 C3a).
question: Is the tax on shares or securities allotted to you by your employer, an eligible start-up, deferred?
